description: This Java class 'EntityUtilProperties' provides utility methods for retrieving and managing configuration properties related to entity management in the OFBiz framework. It includes methods for accessing properties from resource files, database, and URL sources, as well as handling internationalization and property comparison.

classes.name: EntityUtilProperties
classes.description: Final utility class for accessing and managing entity-related configuration properties, including database, resource, and URL-based properties, with support for internationalization and property comparison.
